profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Currently a Lockheed Martin Embedded Software Engineer for the SmartSatellite team, with experience in Application Infrastructure, and full stack web development. My responsibilities include working in DevOps environment developing software toward LM application frameworks, creating and maintaining applications involved with Satellite-ground communication and testing frameworks through Pytest and Gtest within a rhel8 environment. With a BS Degree in Computer Science with a Certificate of Specialization in C++ programming, I’m currently working toward my Master’s in Cybersecurity with a focus on Network Security. My known tech fields are C++, Python with Django frameworks, NumPy and Pandas, Java, HTML5/CSS3, JavaScript, ColdFusion, Git, UNIX, Wireshark, with a slight exposure to AWS and Cloud Computing.  For my free time, I’m self studying Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for practical application.
